description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_neighborhood.md Parts I-II: closed-neighborhood contraction A=N[v] at a cubic vertex, the cubic power-path lemma CN1 and its r=2 closure, and the Type T offset comparison between the triangle atom and the closed-neighborhood atom.
scope_note: Tests only unconditional graph-theoretic mechanics; does not test the minimality-dependent 'p != q' forced-distinct-attachment step (contraction_atoms.md I.4), which can and does fail mechanically on ordinary (non-counterexample) fixtures -- those instances are recorded and skipped, not silently ignored. Kept separate from verifier/contraction_lift.py and verifier/atom_lift.py, whose prior audits are untouched.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
fixtures: 15 random cubic-plus-extra-edge graphs, n in {8,10,12}, seeds 3000..3014
detector_agreement: Every constructed lift/gadget cycle validated by two independent implementations (hand-rolled adjacency traversal verify_cycle, and independently constructed networkx traversal verify_cycle_nx, both imported from verifier/contraction_lift.py); 0 disagreements.
completed_range: All fixtures and gadget parameter ranges processed to completion; cycle enumeration in check_cn1 bounded at length 8 per graph (nx.simple_cycles length_bound=8).
